name: smwgraphics-super-mario-all-stars-super-mario-bros-mario-luigi
title: Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. - Mario & Luigi
description:
Mario and Luigi from the SNES version of Super Mario Bros. Fully adapted to the SMW moveset including cutscene poses, Yoshi, etc.

IMPORTANT: You will need the 32x32 Player Graphics Patch to use this.

Includes:
- Mario.
- Luigi.
- Shared palettes.
- Beta version of Mario + Shared palettes for Beta Mario and Luigi.
- Alternate graphics for Luigi using SMAS poses.
- A file containing various extra poses for Mario and Luigi for use with other patches or custom ASM.
